name: Taksh L0.2 Phase-B overfitting benchmark
provenance: Original examples authored for Taksh L0.2 Phase B (2026-11-10). Train and evaluation share the same 24 examples ON PURPOSE: this is a memorization gate, not a generalization measurement.

problems.name: hello_world
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named hello_world() that returns the string 'Hello, world!'.

problems.name: add_two
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named add_two(a, b) that returns the sum of the two numbers a and b.

problems.name: is_even
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named is_even(n) that returns True if n is even and False otherwise.

problems.name: is_odd
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named is_odd(n) that returns True if n is odd and False otherwise.

problems.name: max_of_two
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named max_of_two(a, b) that returns the larger of the two numbers a and b.

problems.name: reverse_string
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named reverse_string(text) that returns the reversed string.

problems.name: sum_list
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named sum_list(numbers) that returns the sum of the list of numbers. Return 0 for an empty list.

problems.name: factorial
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named factorial(n) that returns n! (n factorial) using a loop. factorial(0) is 1.

problems.name: fibonacci
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named fibonacci(n) that returns the n-th Fibonacci number, with fibonacci(0) equal to 0 and fibonacci(1) equal to 1, using a loop.

problems.name: square_number
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named square_number(n) that returns n squared.

problems.name: cube_number
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named cube_number(n) that returns n cubed.

problems.name: absolute_value
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named absolute_value(n) that returns the absolute value of n.

problems.name: largest_of_three
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named largest_of_three(a, b, c) that returns the largest of the three numbers a, b and c.

problems.name: countdown_from
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named countdown_from(n) that returns a list with the integers from n down to 1.

problems.name: is_prime
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named is_prime(n) that returns True if n is a prime number, otherwise False. n less than 2 is not prime.

problems.name: swap_values
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named swap_values(a, b) that returns a list with b first and a second.

problems.name: double_list
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named double_list(numbers) that returns a list with every number doubled.

problems.name: average_of_two
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named average_of_two(a, b) that returns the average of the two numbers a and b.

problems.name: char_count
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named char_count(text, ch) that returns how many times the single character ch occurs in text.

problems.name: repeat_text
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named repeat_text(text, times) that returns text repeated times times with no separator.

problems.name: greet
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named greet(name) that returns 'Hello, ' followed by name and a '!'.

problems.name: increment_by_two
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named increment_by_two(n) that returns n + 2.

problems.name: first_char
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named first_char(text) that returns the first character of text, or an empty string if text is empty.

problems.name: square_of_sum
problems.instruction: Write a Python function named square_of_sum(a, b) that returns the square of (a + b).
